g.title: PST_F1
g.text: Bosch PST-F1 4-pin. Mount adapter: M14x1.5 female → M10x1.0 male. Pressure output: 0.5V = 0 bar, 4.5V = 10 bar (linear 0-5V). Temp output: NTC thermistor — calibrate in MTune against resistance table. Phase 3: moves to 07K iABED oil housing (M10x1.0 port) unchanged. Product: https://www.bosch-motorsport.com/products/sensors/pressure-and-temperature/pressure-sensor-combined-pst-f-1/

g.title: W_PST_F1
g.text: Engine-side sensor to bulkhead engine plug. Keep away from ignition/coil wires.
